originalPerformanceReport.coverageCriterionSource: Conservative probe evidence-completeness criterion; it does not replace or relax the P0 frame budget.
originalPerformanceReport.operationSchedule: Each second: Roll at 0.00, SkipVisual at 0.25, rotate locked order at 0.50, TogglePending+Refresh at 0.70, ClearPending+Refresh at 0.85. Real autosave and UI preview remain active.

independentFrameClocks.observationStatusLegend: 0 no timing; 1 zero frame-start; 2 repeated frame-start; 3 backward frame-start; 4 new frame-start; 5 new frame-start after skipped Unity observation (delta baseline reset).
independentFrameClocks.deltaStatusLegend: 0 unavailable observation or zero axis; 1 valid current timestamp without adjacent baseline; 2 valid positive difference; 3 non-increasing axis; 4 CPU frequency unavailable.
independentFrameClocks.definitions: Unity 6000.6: frameStartTimestamp is CPU clock when frame started; cpuTimePresentCalled is CPU clock at Present call; cpuTimeFrameComplete is CPU clock when GPU finished rendering and interrupted CPU. Units are converted using GetCpuTimerFrequency.
independentFrameClocks.adjacencyLimit: Differences require adjacent Unity observations with new monotonic frame-start values and a valid monotonic axis. GetLatestTimings(1) does not prove no native records were skipped. No clock replaces the original LateUpdate interval or acceptance criteria.

productionFramePacing.strategyDescription: 60Hz maximum cadence; absolute QPC deadline reanchored to every actual release; ceil(QPC frequency/60); coarse Sleep + <=1.5ms spin tail; first PreLateUpdate child; paused/unfocused Sleep(17ms), no spin or catch-up
productionFramePacing.readTiming: Outside sampling only; public static read-only metadata, never a per-frame reflection call.

limitations: This is automated player operation, not human playtesting, player win rate, or a mobile performance result.
The frame budget check uses P95 of measured frame intervals; CPU Main Thread may include presentation waits. Raw CPU/GPU metrics remain separately available for diagnosis.

Frame-start, Present-called and frame-complete timestamp differences are diagnostic peers of LateUpdate, never replacements for its original verdict. Present-called is not scanout; frame-complete is GPU completion interrupting the CPU. Adjacent unique GetLatestTimings(1) observations may still skip native records; explicit gaps are broken but native adjacency is not guaranteed.
Recorder units and exact marker names are retained. UI marker invocation count is not the number of individual rebuilt elements.

Before sampling, the probe allocates max(60000, ceil(warmup FPS * 180 seconds * 2)) frame records once. Estimated observer bytes cover record payload, not object headers or all profiler overhead. Any expansion during sampling still forces a gap.
GPU durations that are negative, non-finite or longer than the process lifetime are invalid, retained in raw CSV and force a measurement gap; no merely slow frame is filtered by the 16.7ms budget.

Focus is recorded as context, not proof of window visibility. Keep the actual player visible and unminimized; inspect the native player log for swapchain/timestamp warnings that may bypass Unity log callbacks.
Unavailable metrics are null; availability gaps or a non-1080p run cannot certify the complete performance condition. Independent review remains required.
